items.summary: Command injection in TOTOLINK A950RG (lib/cste_modules/product.so UploadCustomModule) via a manipulated FileMd5 argument; remotely exploitable with a published public exploit.
Unauthenticated remote code execution as root in Cisco Expressway Series via persistent cookie manipulation and insufficient certificate validation; network-accessible, no credentials needed.
Critical authentication bypass in Cisco Unified Communications products, one of three Cisco UC auth-bypass flaws patched Oct 23; patch before exposure.

'PHP2Shell': unauthenticated remote code execution in the PHP engine itself via crafted HTTP requests, code present since PHP 5.4 (2012); Cloudflare saw millions of exploit attempts within a day of disclosure.
Second 'PHP2Shell' critical flaw in PHP (companion to CVE-2026-109618), also CVSS 9.2; 34M+ PHP services still unpatched per Censys — patch every PHP web stack immediately.
